theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_weyl_glue
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (F : ℝ → Euclid n → ℝ), 0 < R → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < R → ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ m (F ε) (ball (0 : Euclid n) (R - ε))) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < R → ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) (R - ε), ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 (F ε) y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) → (∀ (ε δ : ℝ) (x : Euclid n), 0 < ε → 0 < δ → ‖x‖ + ε + δ < R → F ε x = F δ x) → ∃ h : Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ m : ℕ, ContDiffOn ℝ m h (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∑ i : Fin n, iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 h y ![EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ), EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)] = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), F ε x = h x
